Subject: Request: extend POC + extra credits for model load test

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency profile and the batch inference options. We hit a wall trying to reproduce our nightly load with the default sandbox quota; the model runs are more token-heavy than we expected.

Two asks:
- Can we get an extra 200k free tokens for the POC so we can run the full 7-day load test?
- Would Redwood consider a 30-day extension to the sandbox window if the tests indicate we’ll need another week of tuning?

I know this is outside the standard PLG limits, so happy to provide a short mutual action plan if that helps. Procurement is copied in case you need an LOA.

Best,

Jordan / Karthik —

Looping you in for a quick approval ask from Acme (copied). They want a one-off uplift to run a 7-day heavy load and a 30-day sandbox extension. Context: Acme is a mid-market prospect (platform + MLOps integration) that surfaced from the PLG funnel and has been active the last 2 weeks. Their usage looks promising but the nightly stress test will exceed the default sandbox cap.

Quick facts:
- Requested uplift: 200,000 free tokens (for POC only)
- Requested extension: +30 days on the sandbox window
- Win signal: integration team committed to a follow-up paid pilot if performance checks out in their load test (high probability).

I've attached their usage PNG and a suggested pricing-exception-form (draft). If we approve, I can:
1) Add a note to HubSpot (deal DEAL-2025-0421) and mark this as a one-off credit.
2) Send an LOA that makes the credit conditional on usage for load testing only and that it does not change the production license terms.

Ask: Can we approve this as a one-off POC concession? If yes, please reply-all with the final amount and any required conditions.

Thanks,
Irene
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Request: extend POC + extra credits for model load test

Irene — thanks for the clear ask and plan. Recommendation from deal desk POV:

- Approve one-off 200k token credit strictly for the POC load test. Mark it as non-recurring and expire at the end of the extended sandbox window.
- Approve 30-day extension to the sandbox with the condition that Acme agrees to a follow-up commercial discussion within that window (we capture in HubSpot).
- Require an LOA signed by Acme acknowledging the credit is for testing only and that any production usage will be billed per standard terms. Use the attached pricing-exception-form.xlsx as the template.

Please flag if finance needs to sign off; amount is below our 1% ARR threshold for formal CFO review but I suggest we record the concession as DEAL-2025-0421, tag as "one-off-credits" in the deal properties, and set an internal expiration date for the credit.

If Jordan is good with this, we can proceed; Irene please push the LOA and update HubSpot.

-Karthik
